basis: The visible dashboard is a cross-sectional scatter of five regions (A–E) on printed “Advertising Spend” and “Sales” axes. It shows a positive association (higher spend regions also have higher sales), but it contains no ROI, profit, experimental/comparison, or incremental-sales annotation. The strongest supported reading (r1) is that this association alone does not meet the evidentiary bar for a broader region-wide approval, so a full regional spend-sales analysis is warranted. The pilot option (r2) is not fully supported because the chart provides no pilot-selection criteria or threshold, and the task text does not establish an organizational pilot policy. The region-wide approval (r3) relies on treating association as decision-sufficient, which is not grounded in the visible evidence.
option_label: Hold recommendation and request full regional spend-sales analysis
